description.value:
Category: Luxury
Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Slots: 14

Iconic Cyberdeck with 14 slots for Programs or Hardware, usable only while installed in a Neuroport Cyberdeck Port. After Jacking In with it, the user fires one non-Black-ICE Program or one Interface Ability for no NET Action. While using it they get one more NET Action each turn. Damaging Quickhacks and Programs run through it roll an extra 1d6 and drop the lowest die before damage lands, and anything it runs that has a duration lasts twice as long.

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Gear).
